title: Antique Brass Modern Retractable Wall Hook - 2-1/2 Inch Pull-Out, Wall Mount Brass Bathroom Hook (15 Lb Capacity), Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep towels and robes within reach without cluttering your bathroom wall—this modern retractable wall hook pulls out when you need it and pushes back in when you don’t in Antique Brass, which features a softened, aged golden patina that brings vintage charm and character to traditional spaces. Backed by a lifetime warranty, it’s a clean, space-saving choice for modern bathroom hardware.

  • Antique Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Holds up to 15 lb for daily-use towels, robes, and clothing
  • Personalizes your look: remove the included knob tip and swap in a cabinet knob of your choice
  • Brass construction for an enduring, modern finish presence

Why it’s different: Unlike mass-market alternatives, this retractable hook uses brass construction and a space-saving wall-mounted design built for everyday bathrooms.

Specs

  • Product type: Retractable wall hook
  • Hanging space (pull-out): 2-1/2" (2.5")
  • Overall dimensions (L x H x W): 2" x 2" x 3.75"
  • Projection: 1"
  • Weight capacity: 15 lb
  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting: Wall mount; fits standard interior walls
  • Installation: Drill 3/4" dia. hole through drywall plus 3 small holes; includes toggle bolts and all mounting hardware (6/32 toggles)
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Lifetime warranty

Complete your bathroom with coordinating pieces to match your modern style.
meta_description: Modern retractable wall hook with 2-1/2" pull-out hanging space. Wall mount brass hook holds 15 lb and retracts flush—backed by a lifetime warranty.
